topic.title: Clarification request: Reproducibility of small fixed index lists shipped inside public datasets
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hi David, Marie — a follow-up to your reproducibility clarifications, on a case that was raised in the “permitted external resources” thread but not yet answered.

Several public candidate-pool datasets ship precomputed fingerprints together with a short list of integer indices saying which columns of a standard RDKit fingerprint vector were kept. The fingerprints themselves can be recomputed from public structures with public code, but the datasets do not include the rule or code that chose those indices.

Does a solution that uses such an index list need to be able to reproduce how the indices were chosen, or is it sufficient that everything computed from the list (fingerprints, models, features) is reproducible given the list as a fixed, documented input?

If the selection must be reproducible, is it acceptable to replace the list with one generated by a participant’s own documented rule, with all dependent artifacts regenerated from it?

A yes/no on each would let teams settle their final pipelines well before the deadline. Thank you.
